title: Fermix management socket protocol, draft version 2
description: DRAFT. Authored in the Fermix macOS application repository from docs/design/MILESTONE_34_NATIVE_SETUP_DESIGN.md section 7.3, not vendored from the engine: protocol v2 is engine work that has not started. The app is built against this artifact while the engine publishes protocol 1, and the pair is a designed transition with an expiry, never a fallback. When the engine publishes protocol 2 this directory is deleted and the vendored management/ tree replaces it; ManagementContractTests fails while both a draft and a protocol-2 engine schema ship. Source of truth on release: FermixCore.Management.Protocol.

result.description: A response carries no method, so the result shape is selected by the method of the correlated request rather than discriminated from the envelope alone.

minimum_versions.description: The minimum protocol version of every method this daemon serves, keyed by method name. Added in v2; absent on a v1 daemon, which serves every method it lists at version 1.

restart_reasons.description: The configuration sections whose change requires a restart. Added in v2; absent on a v1 daemon, where the app renders the plain restart sentence with no reason list.

remediation.description: What to do about this check, in the daemon's own words. Added in v2; absent on a v1 daemon, where the app renders the summary with no action button.

settingValue.description: One row value: a public scalar, a list of strings, or null, which deletes the key where the key allows it.

result.description: Flat and bounded: public scalars only.

fast.description: Fast mode. Boolean because Providers.RouteResolver.validate_fast!/1 accepts only nil or a boolean, and section 5.1 renders it as a Toggle.

read_only.description: Section 7.7's parity gate: a row key that does not round-trip through settings.apply is marked read_only and rendered as a plain labelled row rather than a control whose save always refuses. Not listed in the section 7.3 row column; the gate paragraph is what obliges the daemon to publish it.

unit.description: Section 5's number rows: the unit a value is counted in, rendered as a suffix beside the field. Null where the number counts nothing but itself.

format.description: How a number row reads. `integer` is a plain count; `percent` renders a 0-1 fraction as a percentage; `currency_cents` renders a whole-cent amount as money; `minutes` and `hours` are durations. Null on every non-number row.

result.description: Flat and bounded: public scalars only.

authorize_url.description: Returned once, on the call that starts the flow. Never logged.

auth_import_start_result.description: The completion result carries provider and account_label as flat scalars. Section 7.3's third member, restart {required, reasons}, is nested and cannot ride a flat job result, so the surface re-reads setup.state.get's restart once the job reaches a terminal status.
